Overlapping bold/italic tags are recovered by the HTML parser without panic

```python title="Python"
from html_to_markdown import convert

def main() -> None:
    html = "<p><b><i>bold and italic</b></i></p>"
    result = convert(html)
    print(result)

main()
```
